action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Lhasa incorrectly handled certain LHA archive
headers, leading to an integer underflow. If a user or automated system
were tricked into opening a specially crafted archive, an attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause Lhasa to crash or execute arbitrary code.
isummary:
Lhasa could be made to crash or run programs as your login if it opened a
specially crafted file.
title: Lhasa vulnerability
